# winrt-Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.Search

**IMPORTANT**: Windows App SDK packages cannot be used without the Windows App
Runtime. This has to be installed manually by the end user. Read the
[PyWinRT Windows App SDK documentation](https://pywinrt.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api/microsoft.html)
for more information.

Windows Runtime (WinRT) APIs for the `Microsoft.Windows.Search.AppContentIndex` namespace.

This package provides the `winrt.microsoft.windows.search.appcontentindex` module.

The WinRT APIs in it are those of version 2.5.1 of the
`Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK` NuGet package.

Its metadata comes from the `Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.Search` component,
version 2.5.5.
